description: Combine one or more images (PNG/JPEG/WebP) into a single PDF, one image per page, pages sized to each image. Input: a list of base64-encoded image contents (each max 15 MB / 40 MP). Returns a download_url for the PDF (link valid 24 hours), its size and page count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per month.
name: images_to_pdf
title: Combine images into a PDF
